answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable deposit in a shared vault and prove liveness with a periodic heartbeat pulse: agents that miss several pulses lose their stake and their right to transact. New identities start with whisper-quiet reputation, tiny transaction limits that only grow through consistent, attested work, so creating thousands of fake accounts gains no purchasing power, because each one must earn its way out of the vault's probation one verified pulse at a time.
